interface.title: fiako-anfrek | Frequency Analysis in Hydrology (taruma/anfrek v1.2.0)
interface.field: Hydrology: statistics of extreme rainfall and discharge
interface.stage_of_work: analysis: design-value estimation from an annual-maximum series
interface.what_it_is_for: Load a series of annual maximum rainfall or discharge, check its statistics and outliers, compute return-period magnitudes for Normal, Log Normal, Gumbel and Log Pearson III, test each fit with Kolmogorov-Smirnov and Chi-Square, and download the results.

data.note: I uploaded example_data.csv: R24, 32 annual values (1986–2017, Jan-01 dates), range 36.9–203.0. I also used the built-in 'Example Data (R24, 32 Years)' button, which loads the same series (screens/024.webp). Each tab after Table/Data stays disabled until data is loaded.

tree.general: Estimate design magnitudes for given return periods from an annual-maximum series, and choose the probability distribution that fits best
tree.specific: Run R24 annual maximum rainfall through statistics and outliers, frequency analysis for 4 distributions, and KS / Chi-Square goodness of fit, then download TXT and CSV results

features.name: Filterable data table that feeds the analysis
features.general: Load a series into a table, sort it, and narrow it with typed conditions; the preview chart and all later calculations use only the visible rows
features.specific: Dash DataTable with a filter row per column ('> 80', '< 100') and sort arrows; the bar/line and bubble charts redraw, and Statistics, Frequency and GoF then run on the filtered rows (n=29)
steps: load a CSV or the example data
type a condition in a column's filter box
rerun a downstream Calculate on the subset
serves_tasks: Browse, sort and subset the records; the chart follows
Repeat the statistics on a subset that leaves out extreme values
Run the tests on the filtered subset

features.name: Outlier-bound control chart with box plot
features.general: Plot a series with mean, ±1 SD and computed upper and lower outlier limits, next to a box plot, and export the numbers as a text report
features.specific: STATISTICS & OUTLIER chart: mean, mean±std, upper/lower bound (Grubbs-type Kn on log values) plus a box plot; DOWNLOAD STATOUT.TXT
steps: read which points pass the dotted bounds
serves_tasks: Compute descriptive statistics and outlier bounds and see them over the series

features.name: Moment-criteria distribution screen
features.general: Compare a sample's skew and kurtosis with each candidate distribution's theoretical rule, one small chart per candidate
features.specific: DISTRIBUTION panel: a Cv/Cs/Ck bar chart and markers against the Normal, Log Normal, Gumbel and LP3 criteria lines, with ✓/✗ symbols
steps: see which criteria are met (green) or not (red)
serves_tasks: Screen candidate distributions by moment criteria

features.name: Multi-distribution return-period calculator
features.general: Type a list of return periods, pick a calculation method for each candidate distribution, compute every magnitude at once, compare them in linked charts and export a table
features.specific: OPTIONS: Return Period text field (space-separated) and SOURCE dropdowns (Normal: SCIPY/SOEWARNO; Log Normal: SCIPY/SOEWARNO; Gumbel: GUMBEL/SOEWARNO/SOETOPO/SCIPY/POWELL; LP3: SCIPY/SOEWARNO/SOETOPO/LIMANTARA), CALCULATE, line and bar charts with legend groups, DOWNLOAD FREQUENCY.CSV
serves_tasks: Compute return-period magnitudes for several distributions at once
Rerun with other return periods and other calculation methods
Compare distributions by hiding some in the chart

features.name: Goodness-of-fit test panel (KS and Chi-Square)
features.general: Set a significance level and a critical-value method, test several fitted distributions against the data, inspect the fitted CDFs and class counts visually, see each test statistic against its critical value with the worst point marked, and pick the distribution that passes both tests
features.specific: α spinbutton, Kolmogorov-Smirnov source (SCIPY/SOEWARNO/SOETOPO), Chi-Square source (SCIPY/LIMANTARA), CALCULATE; rank plot, empirical vs fitted CDFs, 5-class Chi-Square bins; RESULTS bars for Δcritical vs Δmax and X²critical vs X², hover gives dmax; DOWNLOAD ALL RESULTS (KS.csv, CHI.csv, FIT.TXT)
steps: choose the KS and Chi-Square sources
inspect the CDF and Chi-Square class plots and hover the Δmax markers
read pass/fail against the critical bars and pick the distribution that passes both
serves_tasks: Run goodness-of-fit tests at a significance level and inspect the fits visually
Rerun the tests with another significance level and other critical-value methods
Read the worst-deviation point for each distribution
Choose the distribution that passes both tests
